e.title_en: An extension that fills both usernames and passwords and one-time verification codes into insurance portals on the user behalf, created and updated within three days in May, with one daily user, an all-rights-reserved licence, no homepage and no repository, and a risk surface this entry states plainly: handing credentials and one-time codes to an extension moves the entire trust boundary.

e.summary: **Darshana Insurance Auto-Login**（Firefox 扩展 `darshana-insurance-auto-login`）**是一个**在**保险门户上**自动填**登录凭据与**一次性验证码**的**浏览器扩展****——**逐字自述为**「**Automatically fills login credentials and OTP verification codes on insurance portals.**」**。**本次实测**：**创建 **2026-05-22**、**最后更新 **2026-05-25**、**版本 **`1.1.0`**、**包体 **24,798 字节****、**⭐ 日活为 **1****、**许可逐字为 **`All Rights Reserved`****、**⭐ 无**主页**、**无**仓库地址**、**发布者逐字为 **`DIC`****。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**浏览器里的保险工具**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **⭐ 它把**「**一次性验证码**」**也纳入**自动填写范围****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**必须**单独标注**：**⭐ 即**多因素认证**的设计意图**是**「**第二因素**不与被窃取的第一因素**同处一地**」**，**而**把**验证码**交给**同一扩展**会**削弱**这一意图**；**⭐ 本条**如实记录**这一功能**，**并**不主张**其**是否**存在**相应的**安全措施**；**② **⭐ 它的**目标**是**「**保险门户**」**——**⭐ 即**保险业的**工作流**里**有**大量**需要**反复登录的**外部系统**（**承保、**理赔、**保司后台**）**——**⭐ 而**「**自动登录**」**正是**这类**重复劳动**的直接**自动化**；**③ **⚠️ 可核查性极低****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**无主页**、**无仓库**、**许可保留全部权利**、**日活 **1****（**⭐ 即**本次**几乎**看不到**任何**外部信息**可用**以**判断**它**如何处理**凭据**）**；**④ **⚠️ 而**与之**对照**，**同一平台**上**另一条**保险相关扩展**的自述**只有一句**（**见本轮另一条）**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这个面上的**共同问题**是**：**「**自述一句话 ＋ **闭源 ＋ **少人用**」**三者**同时**出现**时**，**外部**无法**做**任何**实质**评估**。**⚠️ 本次**未安装、**未使用**。
e.summary_hk: **Darshana Insurance Auto-Login**（Firefox 擴充 `darshana-insurance-auto-login`）**是一個**在**保險門戶上**自動填**登入憑據與**一次性驗證碼**的**瀏覽器擴充****——**逐字自述為**「**Automatically fills login credentials and OTP verification codes on insurance portals.**」**。**本次實測**：**創建 2026-05-22**、**最後更新 2026-05-25**、**版本 `1.1.0`**、**包體 24,798 位元組**、**⭐ 日活為 1****、**許可逐字為 `All Rights Reserved`**、**⭐ 無**主頁**、**無**倉庫位址**、**發布者逐字為 `DIC`****。**⭐⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**瀏覽器裡的保險工具**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四處最值得看**：**① **⭐ 它把「**一次性驗證碼**」也納入自動填寫範圍**——**⭐ 即**多因素認證的設計意圖是「**第二因素不與被竊取的第一因素同處一地**」**，**而把驗證碼交給同一擴充會削弱這一意圖**；**② **⭐ 它的目標是「**保險門戶**」**——**⭐ 即**保險業工作流裡有大量需反覆登入的外部系統**；**③ **⚠️ 可核查性極低**（**無主頁、**無倉庫、**許保留全部權利、**日活 1**）**；**④ **⚠️ 與同平台另一條保險擴充一樣**，「**自述一句話＋**閉源＋**少人用**」三者同時出現時**，**外部無法做任何實質評估**。**⚠️ 本次**未安裝、**未使用**。
e.summary_en: This extension **fills login credentials and one-time verification codes into insurance portals on the user behalf**, described verbatim as automatically filling credentials and one-time codes on insurance portals. **Measured this round**: created and updated three days apart in May at version 1.1.0, a package of about twenty-five kilobytes, one daily user, an all-rights-reserved licence, no homepage, no repository and a publisher name that is an abbreviation. **This entry belongs to the round theme of insurance tooling inside the browser.** **Four things are worth reading: it extends automation to one-time verification codes, which this entry flags separately because the point of a second factor is that it does not sit in the same place as the first, so handing the code to the same extension weakens that intent, and this entry records the feature without claiming whether any compensating control exists; its target is insurance portals, which is telling because the insurance working day involves repeated logins to many external systems for underwriting, claims and insurer back offices, so automatic login is the direct automation of that repetition; verifiability is very low, with no homepage, no repository, an all-rights-reserved licence and a single daily user, so almost no external information exists to judge how it handles credentials; and together with another insurance extension on the same platform whose description is one sentence, the shared problem of this surface is that a one-sentence description, a closed licence and negligible usage appear at the same time, leaving an outsider with no basis for any substantive assessment.** **The extension was not installed or used this round.**
e.body:
**Darshana Insurance Auto-Login**（Firefox 扩展 `darshana-insurance-auto-login`）**是一个**在**保险门户上**自动填**登录凭据与**一次性验证码**的**浏览器扩展****——**逐字自述为**「**Automatically fills login credentials and OTP verification codes on insurance portals.**」**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**浏览器里的保险工具**」**。

**可核实信息（均 Mozilla 扩展登记接口实测）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**一次性验证码**」**也纳入**自动填写范围****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**必须**单独标注**：**⭐ 即**多因素认证**的设计意图**是**「**第二因素**不**与**可能被窃取的**第一因素**同处一地**」**，**而**把**验证码**交给**同一个扩展**会**削弱**这一意图**——**⭐ 本条**如实**记录**这一功能**，**但**不主张**其**是否**存在**补偿性措施**（**如**本地加密、**凭据不出本机**等）**，**也**不主张**它**是否**违反**任何**门户的使用条款**。**⭐⭐ ② 目标写的是「**保险门户**」，**而**这**恰好**是**保险业**的**日常形态****——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**值得记**：**⭐ 即**保险业的**工作流**里**有**大量**需要**反复登录的**外部系统**（**承保、**理赔、**保司后台与**比价平台**）**——**⭐ 而**「**自动登录**」**正是**对这类**重复劳动**的直接**自动化**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**这**也**提示**了**一个**真实问题**：**若**一家机构**真的**要**自动化**这些**门户**，**它**需要**处理**的是**凭据管理**与**授权边界**，**而**不只是**页面填充**。**⭐⭐ ③ ⚠️ 可核查性极低****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**日活为 **1****、**许可逐字为 **`All Rights Reserved`****、**⭐ 无**主页**、**无**仓库地址**、**发布者逐字为 **`DIC`****（**⭐ 三个字母）**；**⭐ 包体 **24,798 字节****、**版本 **`1.1.0`****、**创建 **2026-05-22**、**最后更新 **2026-05-25****（**⭐ 即**发布后**三天**内**有过一次**更新**，**此后**无更新**）**。**⭐ 本词条**据此**如实指出**：**⭐ 外部**几乎**没有任何**可用于**评估它**如何处理**凭据**的信息**——**⭐ 而**凭据处理**恰恰**是**浏览器扩展**里**最需要**被评估的部分**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 与同一平台**另一条**保险相关扩展**共同的问题****——**⭐ 本轮**另有一条**只有**一句自述**、**同样**闭源**、**日活为 **0** 的保险扩展**（**见本轮另一条）**；**⭐ 本词条认为**把**两者**并读**可以**看出**这一**面上的**共同形态**：**⭐ 即**「**自述一句话 ＋ **许可保留全部权利 ＋ **无仓库 ＋ **极少使用者**」**四件**同时**出现**——**⭐ 而**在**这种**组合下**，**外部**既**不能**审计**，**也**不能**从**使用者反馈**里**获得**任何**信号**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[application-fill-provenance]] 覆盖**材料来路**、**[[cyber-risk-platform]] 与**[[cyber-risk-classification]] 覆盖**网络安全风险**、**[[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] 与**[[ifraudsimulator]] 覆盖**欺诈风险**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**门户登录凭据与**一次性验证码**一起**自动化**的**保险浏览器扩展**，**并**由此**暴露**凭据**信任边界**」这一形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较****。

**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 本条最值得借的四件事**：**① **凡**涉及**凭据**的自动化**，**要**先问**信任边界**在**哪里**；**② **第二因素**自动化的**代价**要**写明**；**③ **门户的**使用条款**可能**禁止**这类自动化**（**⭐ 本条**未核实**）；**④ **评估**一个**闭源工具**时**，**「**自述一句话**、**无仓库、**无人用**」**应被**当作**信号**，**而**不是**当作**中立**。

**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有安装、**没有使用**该扩展**（**未在任何**保险门户上**尝试登录**）**，**故**不主张**其**功能**、**不主张**其**凭据处理方式**、**也**不主张**其**是否**符合**任何**门户的**使用条款**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**扩展登记接口返回的**元数据**（**名称、**发布者、**版本、**日活、**许可、**包体大小与**链接字段**）**，**未读**其**包内容**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**发布者身份**（**⭐ 只知**三个字母的**显示名**）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**是否**会**把凭据**发送**到**任何**外部**（**⭐ 本词条**不推测**其行为**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**文中**涉及的任何**保险门户**是否**允许**此类自动化**。**⑥ ⚠️ **日活为 **1****，**故**本条**不主张**它**已被**广泛使用**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-11 所见**；**⚠️ 并如实提示**：**本条**不是**安全评估**，**读者**若**考虑**使用**任何**自动登录工具**，**应**自行**做**安全与**合规判断**。

e.body_hk:
**Darshana Insurance Auto-Login**（Firefox 擴充 `darshana-insurance-auto-login`）**是一個**在**保險門戶上**自動填**登入憑據與**一次性驗證碼**的**瀏覽器擴充****——**逐字自述為**「**Automatically fills login credentials and OTP verification codes on insurance portals.**」**。**⭐ 本條目屬於本輪主題**「**瀏覽器裡的保險工具**」**。

**可核實資訊（均 Mozilla 擴充登記介面實測）**：**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它把「**一次性驗證碼**」也納入自動填寫範圍****——**⭐ 即**多因素認證的設計意圖是「**第二因素不與可能被竊取的第一因素同處一地**」**，**而把驗證碼交給同一個擴充會削弱這一意圖**——**⭐ 本條**如實記錄這一功能**，**但**不主張**其是否存在補償性措施**，**也不主張**其是否違反任何門戶的使用條款**。**⭐⭐ ② 目標寫的是「**保險門戶**」****——**⭐ 即**保險業工作流裡有大量需反覆登入的外部系統**（**承保、**理賠、**保司後台與**比價平台**）**——**⭐ 對 RIAA**：**若真要自動化這些門戶**，**要處理的是憑據管理與授權邊界**，**不只是頁面填充**。**⭐⭐ ③ ⚠️ 可核查性極低****——**日活為 1****、**許可逐字為 `All Rights Reserved`**、**⭐ 無**主頁**、**無**倉庫位址**、**發布者逐字為 `DIC`****；**包體 24,798 位元組**、**版本 `1.1.0`**、**創建 2026-05-22**、**最後更新 2026-05-25****——**⭐ 即**外部幾乎沒有任何可用於評估它如何處理憑據的資訊**。**⭐⭐ ④ ⚠️ 與同平台另一條保險擴充共同的問題****——**本輪另一條只有一句自述、**同樣閉源、**日活為 0**——**⭐ 即**「**自述一句話＋**許保留全部權利＋**無倉庫＋**極少使用者**」四件同時出現**，**外部既不能審計**，**也無法從使用者反饋獲得信號**。**⭐⭐ ⑤ 與池內條目的關係**：[[application-fill-provenance]]、[[cyber-risk-platform]]、[[cyber-risk-classification]]、[[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]]、[[ifraudsimulator]]——**⭐ 本條補上的是**「**把門戶登入憑據與一次性驗證碼一起自動化的保險瀏覽器擴充，**並由此暴露憑據信任邊界**」這一形態**。

**對 RIAA**：**⭐ 四件事值得借**：**① **凡涉及憑據的自動化要先問信任邊界在哪**；**② **第二因素自動化的代價要寫明**；**③ **門戶使用條款可能禁止這類自動化（**未核實**）**；**④ **「**自述一句話、**無倉庫、**無人用**」應被當作信號**。

**⚠️ 本詞條如實標註**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**沒有安裝、**沒有使用**該擴充**，**不主張**其功能**、**憑據處理方式**，**也不主張**其是否符合任何門戶的使用條款**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只讀擴充登記介面返回的元資料**，**未讀**其包內容**。**③ ⚠️ 未核實**發布者身份**（**只知三個字母的顯示名**）**。**④ ⚠️ 未核實**其是否會把憑據發送到任何外部**（**不推測其行為**）**。**⑤ ⚠️ 未核實**文中涉及的任何保險門戶是否允許此類自動化**。**⑥ ⚠️ 日活為 1**，**不主張**它已被廣泛使用**。**⑦ ⚠️ 本條目所記為 2026-09-11 所見**；**⚠️ 本條不是安全評估**。

e.body_en:
This extension **fills login credentials and one-time verification codes into insurance portals on the user behalf**, described verbatim as automatically filling credentials and one-time codes on insurance portals. **This entry belongs to the round theme of insurance tooling inside the browser.**

**Verified information, all measured from the Mozilla add-on registry interface**: **first, it extends automation to one-time verification codes, which this entry flags separately.** The point of a second factor is that it does not sit in the same place as a first factor that might be stolen, so handing the code to the same extension weakens that intent. **This entry records the feature without claiming whether any compensating control exists, such as local-only storage, and without claiming whether it breaches any portal terms of use.** **Second, its stated target is insurance portals, which is exactly the shape of the insurance working day.** Underwriting, claims and insurer back offices, along with comparison platforms, all involve repeated logins to external systems, **so automatic login is the direct automation of that repetition; for this project it also points at the real problem, namely that automating such portals requires handling credential management and authorisation boundaries, not merely filling fields.** **Third, verifiability is very low**: one daily user, an all-rights-reserved licence, no homepage, no repository and a three-letter publisher name, with a package of about twenty-five kilobytes at version 1.1.0, created in May and last updated three days later with nothing since. **Externally there is almost no information with which to judge how it handles credentials, which is precisely the part of a browser extension most in need of assessment.** **Fourth, it shares a problem with another insurance extension on the same platform**, whose description is a single sentence, which is likewise closed and which has no visible users. **Read together they show the shared shape of this surface: a one-sentence description, an all-rights-reserved licence, no repository and negligible usage appearing at once, a combination under which an outsider can neither audit the tool nor draw any signal from user feedback.** **Fifth, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover the provenance of application material, cyber risk platforms and classifications, and insurance fraud risk scoring, **while this entry supplies a browser extension that automates both portal credentials and one-time codes for insurance, and the credential trust boundary that comes with it. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**

**For RIAA**: **four practices transfer: ask where the trust boundary sits before automating anything involving credentials; state the cost of automating a second factor; recognise that portal terms may prohibit such automation, which this entry did not verify; and treat a one-sentence description, no repository and no visible users as a signal rather than as neutral.**

**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, the extension was neither installed nor used**, no login was attempted on any insurance portal, **so no claim is made about its functionality, about how it handles credentials, or about compliance with any portal terms of use**. **Second, only the metadata returned by the registry was read**, not the package contents. **Third, the publisher identity was not verified**, only a three-letter display name being visible. **Fourth, whether it transmits credentials anywhere was not verified, and this entry does not speculate about its behaviour. Fifth, whether any portal named in this context permits such automation was not verified. Sixth, with a single daily user this entry does not claim wide usage. Seventh, this entry records what was visible on 2026-09-11 and states plainly that it is not a security assessment, and that anyone considering an automatic login tool should make their own security and compliance judgement.**
